correctness.rationale: The full linearized infection generator is beta0*Phi*diag(1,...,zeta)*Phi-gamma*I. Multiplication and commuting zero-sum projection give the closed transverse generator beta0*B^2-gamma*I. Real symmetric B has eigenvalues bounded in absolute value by 1-q, hence the exact sharp uniform decay exponent. The family B_alpha=(1-q)[alpha I+(1-alpha)J] achieves both limits and all interior exponents. The 2-dimensional positive quotient lift proves the common reproduction number. Universal proof is algebraic; the embedded exact-rational checker passed 342 families, without substituting sampling for proof.

value.rationale: The natural dynamical invariant is the largest exponential decay time for between-community infection contrasts. Its exact sharp range distinguishes all mobility networks with the same invasion threshold, including regimes with growing principal infection mode. The theorem characterizes extremal and all interpolating cases on connected networks of every admissible size. This structural epidemiological information is absent from a threshold-only comparison and is not an arbitrary slice or table recomputation.
